examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Single thumb over 0–100 in steps of 1, bound with `v-model` and composed in a `Field`: the label names the slider and the current value sits at the end of the label row.

examples.name: Ticks
examples.summary: A tick mark under every step. Ticks render only when the range has at most 21 positions.

examples.name: ReferenceValues
examples.summary: Labelled landmarks under the track. `unit` is appended to each label and to the announced value.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.summary: Disabled: skipped by Tab, ignores pointer and keys, and uses the disabled tokens; the `Field` greys its label.

examples.name: Invalid
examples.summary: Invalid: the `Field` is `invalid`, the fill and thumb border switch to the danger tokens, aria-invalid is set and `Field.Error` says what to change.
